subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “On cloudy days, it dropped.”?
options: Students began checking the screen like a game.
Students began checking the station to see how much rain had fallen.
At first, students thought it was a game.
and began asking, "What do students need to understand?"

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「On cloudy days, it dropped. Students began checking the screen like a game.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students began checking the station to see how much rain had fallen.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「At first, students thought it was a game.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「and began asking, 'What do students need to understand?'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「On cloudy days, it dropped. Students began checking the screen like a game.」，答案為「Students began checking the screen like a game.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students began checking the screen like a game.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
